root.name: Scandinavian Defense: Panov Transfer
root.moves: 1. e4 d5 2. exd5 Nf6 3. c4 c6

overview: Black hits d5 with ...c6, and White usually plays 4.d4 cxd5 to reach a Caro-Kann Panov-Botvinnik structure with an isolated queen's pawn for White, or 4.dxc6 Nxc6 where Black has given a pawn for development (the Scandinavian Gambit). In the main transposition White has an IQP and active pieces while Black blockades d4 and trades pieces, so it plays like a Panov-Botvinnik Caro-Kann.

white_ideas.idea: Build a classical IQP centre with d4, Nc3, Bg5 or Bd3 and use the active pieces
Attack the kingside before Black trades into an endgame
Accept the gambit pawn with dxc6 and hold it with accurate development

black_ideas.idea: Blockade the d4 isolani and trade pieces, aiming for an endgame
Recapture with ...Nxc6 and use the lead in development if White grabs

typical_structures.structure: IQP: White d4 pawn isolated with open c- and e-files against Black's blockade

character.notes: Standard IQP play in the main line; sharper in the 4.dxc6 gambit; neither especially solid nor risky.

gambit.notes: In the 4.d4 cxd5 main line the pawn is recovered by force and no material is given; the 4.dxc6 gambit branch is minor.

soundness.notes: Sound; Black reaches a normal Panov structure.

structure.notes: Exchange-type structure with a half-open file and an isolated queen's pawn; semi-open.

approach.notes: A recognised branch of the Scandinavian that strong players use, standard.

level.notes: IQP plans and piece activity matter more than memory.

sublines_that_differ.name: Scandinavian Gambit Accepted
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 d5 2. exd5 Nf6 3. c4 c6 4. dxc6
sublines_that_differ.how: White takes the pawn and Black plays for development; a sharper gambit.

character.reason: IQP middlegame with real play but no forcing theory.

gambit.reason: In the main transposition the pawn comes back; the gambit is a minor branch.

soundness.reason: Both sides reach a normal position.

structure.reason: Exchange structure with an open c-file and IQP.

approach.reason: A recognised branch of the Scandinavian.

plans.reason: The Panov structure gives White an isolated d-pawn.
